name: Monitor a competitor's TikTok ads into Google Sheets

parameters.content:
## Watch a competitor's TikTok ads

### How it works

Every morning this searches TikTok's public Ads Library for one advertiser and upserts each ad into a Google Sheet, keyed on the ad ID. Ads the competitor is still running update in place; anything new simply appears as a new row, so the sheet becomes a running history of their creative without any duplicate handling on your side.

A single Slack message then reports how many ads are live today, so nobody has to watch the sheet.

### The sheet

Columns are created from the data on first run. `ad_id` is the key the upsert matches on, and `first_shown_at` / `last_shown_at` tell you how long each ad has been running.

### Setup

1. Install `n8n-nodes-tiktok-apify` from **Settings → Community nodes**.
2. Add an **Apify API** credential — free account at [apify.com](https://apify.com?fpr=bucho&fp_sid=n8n). On n8n Cloud you can use **OAuth2** instead and skip the token.
3. Connect Google Sheets and Slack.
4. Point the Sheets node at your spreadsheet and pick a Slack channel.
5. Run once by hand, check the sheet, then enable the schedule.

### Set the advertiser you care about

Search Type is **Advertiser**, so the query is a brand name rather than free text. Country picks which Ads Library market to read — GB, DE, FR, ES and so on.
